influences.name: The Doors
influences.context: The transformative moment came when Rossi and Parfitt heard The Doors' "Roadhouse Blues" in Germany. "That song is where the Quo twelve-bar boogie shuffle came from," Rossi explains.

influences.name: Jimi Hendrix
influences.context: He plays the intro to Hendrix's "Hey Joe" before seamlessly transitioning into "Pictures of Matchstick Men," underscoring how artists borrow from one another.
